description: Search 195 Mandarin grammar points by keyword, by HSK level, or both. A keyword can be English (comparison, passive), a Chinese marker (把, 了) or a term name. Returns matching points with a one-paragraph summary and the slug that get_grammar_point takes. Use this to find which grammar point covers a pattern. Do not use it for vocabulary questions.

level.description: Only return points taught at this HSK level.

query.description: One or more keywords. Every keyword must match.

name: search_grammar
title: Search Chinese grammar points
